news.headline: Rare Baby Rhino Takes Its First Steps
news.body: A greater one-horned rhino calf was born at Chester Zoo in the UK to mum Asha after a 15-month pregnancy. Cameras caught the newborn standing up and taking wobbly first steps in less than an hour. Mum and baby are healthy, and this species is under threat of extinction.

news.headline: Six-Year-Old Smashes Rubik's Cube Record
news.body: Six-year-old Lian Yunzhi from China broke the women's Rubik's Cube world record twice in three days. She solved the cube in 4.52 seconds and then in just 4.27 seconds. That is faster than most people can blink a few times!
